skillset.skill: 13s CT - 2400% Light DMG (MAG). Increase own Arts by 40. For 4s, heal allies' HP by 500/s.
skillset.arts: 17000% Light DMG (MAG). For 25s, increase allies' MAG RES by 25% and allies gain a DMG barrier that negates 12000 DMG.
skillset.truearts: 30000% Light DMG (MAG). Cure allies' Status ailments (except Faint). For 30s, increase allies' stats by 40%.
skillset.superarts: 150000% Light DMG (MAG). Cleanse 1 DMG RES debuff from each ally. For 30s, increase allies' CRI rate and CRI DMG by 100%.

passive.ability1: Increase allies' DMG RES by 30%. When an ally takes lethal DMG, heal ally's HP to 100% and increase ally's Arts by 200. Ability can only be activated once per Quest.
passive.ability3: When near-death, increase DMG RES by 15%.
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Madoka's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Madoka's SP. Art is owned)
